text.tspan: Step 6
Since the P-value = 0.0006 is less than
α
, we reject the null hypothesis.
There is statistical evidence to conclude that
the proportion of Americans who had received
at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine was
lower in December 2021 that it was in July
In context, this means that there is about a 6 in 10,000 chance that this sample proportion (or lower)
would occur in a sample of 148 individuals if the rate of vaccination in December 2021 was 78%, as
it is reported to be today. Remember that the P-Value is the probability of a type 1 error. So, there
is a 6 in 10,000 chance that we are rejecting the null hypothesis, even though it is true. For that
reason, it seems logical to conclude that the rate was lower in December 2021.
